title: Rewind return to the left boundary
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration of the rewind machine on input $x$ whose state is the start state. Embed the rewind machine among the same $k$ work tapes while returning its emitted symbols to the output. There is a time $T$ at which the resulting machine has the same configuration as $c$ in every respect except that its state is the return state and its input-head position is $1$; before time $T$ it never has the return state, and through time $T$ every work-tape head position agrees with that of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of the rewind machine on $x$
The state of $c$ is the start state
